kapak.alt: The right pitch, even on the phone

youtube.baslik: Phones cut low sounds; how does a male voice keep its pitch? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: A telephone line cuts sound below about 300 hertz, yet we still hear a male voice at the right pitch, because the harmonics carry it. The regularity of the harmonics is perceived as the pitch of a fundamental that is not there. This is called the missing fundamental, and the pitch heard is called the residue pitch.

cumleler: Phones cut low sounds; how does a male voice keep its pitch?
A telephone line cuts sound below about three hundred hertz.
Yet a male voice keeps its pitch, because the harmonics carry it.
The harmonics' regularity is heard as the pitch of the absent fundamental.
This is the missing fundamental; the pitch heard is the residue pitch.
